sources.title: Rafael Pass — A Course in Networks and Markets, Chapter 8: Matching Markets
sources.date_scope: Author-hosted HTML. Title page names Rafael Pass alone. Copyright page says ©2018 and catalogues MIT Press [2019]; preserve that distinction rather than inventing an edition date.

actual_inspection.text: Sections 8.1–8.3: unit-demand valuation-minus-price model; outside allocation; preferred-choice graph/market clearing; cancellation of payments and proof of welfare optimality. Title and copyright pages read separately.

sources.use: Assignment utility and ownership accounting; our direct nonnegative price/utility upper bound gives a complete certificate for all feasible partial assignments, including a forbidden edge.
sources.limits: No reliance on the general price-existence algorithm of section 8.4, Hall theorem, general LP integrality, budgets-as-quasilinear equivalence, or source examples. Cornell Chapter 14 was discovery reading only; its abbreviated complete-market incentive proof is not a relied source.

actual_inspection.text: I.A–C, printed 901–904 / physical 4–7: game, quadratic payoff, nonnegative best replies and active sets. V.C printed 918–919 / physical 21–22: endogenous peer outcomes, constraints and selection cautions. VI.A printed 919–920 / physical 22–23: complements, nonexistence and caps. Appendix printed 921–922 / physical 24–25: active-set proof and quadratic potential conditions.

Complementarity amplification/nonexistence, capped best reply, and scope of sufficient curvature conditions.

sources.use: Economic interpretation of complements/substitutes and boundary active-set logic. Our finite path/two-agent solutions, contraction proof, planner square completion and funding incidence are derived independently.
sources.limits: Do not conflate the potential with aggregate welfare, own-action concavity with uniqueness, or an inverse matrix with a feasible equilibrium. No general spectral characterization, asymptotic stability, directed-network or empirical-identification result is asserted without its own proof. The gamma=2 two-agent case is independently proved outside the paper’s base delta∈[0,1].
